title: Two Characters
description: Given a string, remove characters until the string is made up of any two alternating characters. When you choose a character to remove, all instances of that character must be removed. Determine the longest string possible that contains just two alternating letters.
input_format:
The first line contains a single integer that denotes the length of s.
The second line contains string s.
output_format: Print the length of the longest valid string that can be formed, or 0 if none can be formed.
